tools.name: probe_agent
tools.description: Fetch and cache a remote agent's A2A card (/.well-known/agent-card.json, falling back to /.well-known/agent.json). Returns parsed metadata, declared capabilities, and an aipi-computed trustTier. Identical bytes to POST /api/v2/agents/probe.

tools.name: issue_receipt
tools.description: Submit a caller-signed receipt of an agent-to-agent interaction. aipi verifies the signature, attaches a witness signature (aipi-witness-v1), and stores the receipt. Idempotent on receipt-hash. Identical bytes to POST /api/v2/agents/receipts.

tools.name: get_reputation
tools.description: Compute a remote agent's reputation from witnessed receipts — success rate, latency percentiles, sample size, and low-confidence flag. Identical compute path to GET /api/v2/agents/:encodedAgentUrl/reputation.

tools.name: aipi_get_capabilities
tools.description: List the aipi intelligence agents and the metrics each one can produce. Takes no arguments. Ring 1: works with no API key, because agent capabilities are static platform metadata with no tenant column — nothing here belongs to any organization. tools.description: Return the step-by-step signup guide for agents, as Markdown (also published at https://agents.analyticalinsider.ai/agent-signup.md). It uses only the discovery document's own field names and states no price, plan or limit. No key needed.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "comms_start_signup" is 1557 chars, far longer than this server's median (242). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: probe_agent, comms_get_offer · Private data: aipi_get_capabilities, comms_get_offer, comms_start_signup, comms_get_signup_guide · Public sink: probe_agent, issue_receipt, comms_get_offer, comms_start_signup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: probe_agent, comms_get_offer · Private data: aipi_get_capabilities, comms_get_offer, comms_start_signup, comms_get_signup_guide · Public sink: probe_agent, issue_receipt, comms_get_offer, comms_start_signup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
